subject: BlueWave renewal: capacity uplift & QBR scheduling
summary: Kickoff thread to align on renewal term, proposed capacity uplift, pricing options, and to schedule the QBR. External team requested cost estimate and a short pilot window for burst capacity; internal team to prepare MAP and pricing scenarios for discussion.
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Torres <atorres@bluewave.com>, Priya Shah <pshah@bluewave.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 9 Apr 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: BlueWave renewal: capacity uplift & QBR scheduling

Hi Alex / Priya —

Happy Friday (early). We're approaching BlueWave's renewal window in mid-May and I wanted to kick off coordination so we can align on term length, the capacity uplift you've signaled, and lock a QBR date. High-level ask:

- Confirm target start date for increased throughput (you mentioned "early June" in the exec call)
- Confirm stakeholders for procurement and engineering (we'll need an ops contact for the capacity runbook)
- Pick a 60-min QBR slot in the next two weeks so we can review traffic, MAP, pricing scenarios, and a proposed pilot for burst capacity

I've attached a draft mutual action plan (BlueWave_MAP_v1.pdf) and a couple of pricing scenarios (pricing_options_v3.xlsx). Our internal recommended timeline is:

1) This week — QBR to align scope & stakeholders
2) Next 2 weeks — finalize MAP and pricing; legal/finance kickoff as needed
3) Early June — target capacity uplift + 2-week pilot for burst if you want to validate throughput in production

Proposed QBR slots (PST):
- Tue Apr 11, 10:00–11:00
- Wed Apr 12, 14:00–15:00
- Thu Apr 13, 09:00–10:00

Can you confirm which works? If those don't, propose a couple of times and we'll adjust.

Next steps from our side after QBR: finalize MAP, price the uplift, and (if agreed) spin up reserved capacity in a sandbox for your engineers.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0183

Attachments: BlueWave_MAP_v1.pdf, pricing_options_v3.xlsx

From: Alex Torres <atorres@bluewave.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Shah <pshah@bluewave.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 9 Apr 2028 11:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BlueWave renewal: capacity uplift & QBR scheduling

Grace —

Thanks for the note and the materials. BlueWave is definitely interested in a term that extends to 24 months with a staged throughput uplift. A few quick things from our side:

- We've exported an abbreviated usage report for the last 60 days (attached: BW_usage_apr2028.csv) so you can size the uplift more precisely.
- Procurement will want a clear delta on unit price for reserved capacity vs hosted burst; can your team outline both "staircase" and "flat" pricing in the QBR?
- We may want a 10–14 day pilot of reserved capacity before committing to a full billing cycle — can Redwood support that?

For QBR slots, Tue Apr 11 10:00 PST works for Alex and Priya. If something comes up I can loop procurement as procurement@bluewave.com.

Appreciate it — see you Tuesday.

—Alex
Alex Torres
Head of ML Infrastructure | BlueWave Analytics
atorres@bluewave.com | (212) 555-4412

Attachments: BW_usage_apr2028.csv

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Apr 2028 08:02:00 -0700
Subject: RE: BlueWave renewal: capacity uplift & QBR scheduling (internal)

Internal notes / action items before the QBR (Tue 4/11 10:00 PST confirmed by customer):

- Grace: lead discovery and confirm procurement participants — ask Alex to add procurement@bluewave.com to the thread if they want procurement on the call. (DONE: Alex indicated he may loop them.)
- David: prepare two pricing scenarios (staircase and flat) and a short one-pager on pilot mechanics (2-week reserved capacity pilot, billing holdback language). Use pricing_options_v3.xlsx as base and add unit economics at the 95th/99th pctl traffic shapes.
- Ben: run a stack check with infra to confirm a sandbox reserved pool we can spin up for a 10–14 day pilot (include cost to provision + warm-up time). If GPU scheduling requires a 48–72 hour lead, flag it now so we can set correct expectations.
- Marissa: I'll prepare the QBR deck skeleton: usage snapshot, MAP, pricing delta, pilot plan, and runway for rollout. Will include a short appendix on SLA expectations for the uplift.

Other notes: push for a 24-month term with a 6-month step-up (25% at month 1, additional 25% at month 6) — gives them runway and gives us predictability.

I'll attach the draft QBR deck to the HubSpot deal after the call.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Torres <atorres@bluewave.com>, Priya Shah <pshah@bluewave.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Apr 2028 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BlueWave renewal: capacity uplift & QBR scheduling

Thanks for confirming, Alex — great. Per Marissa's note, we've put a short agenda together for the 60-min QBR (Tue 4/11 10:00–11:00 PST):

1) 10m — Introductions & goals for renewal (term, runway, success criteria)
2) 15m — Usage & shape review (Grace, Marissa)
3) 15m — Pricing scenarios (David)
4) 10m — Pilot mechanics & infra readiness (Ben)
5) 10m — Next steps & signoffs (Grace)

I'll share the QBR deck link in 30 minutes (short view-only link). FYI Alex — we can support a 10–14 day pilot of reserved capacity; Ben will confirm lead times but we typically need 48–72 hours to provision and warm. If procurement wants an agreement appendix for a trial, we can surface a billing holdback clause in the MAP.

Quoted for context: "We may want a 10–14 day pilot of reserved capacity before committing to a full billing cycle — can Redwood support that?" — Alex Torres (see below).

See you on the call.

Best,
Grace

Related: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/3421
Attachments: BlueWave_MAP_v1.pdf

From: Priya Shah <pshah@bluewave.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Alex Torres <atorres@bluewave.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 11 Apr 2028 16:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BlueWave renewal: capacity uplift & QBR scheduling

Grace / team —

Thanks for the agenda and the materials. Tue 4/11 10:00 PST works for our side — confirmed. A couple of asks before the QBR so we can prep:

1) Can you include the 60-day usage export (we already sent one but if there's an internal processed view you can share that helps our engineers)
2) For the pilot: we want the pilot to include real traffic routing (not synthetic) and a short rollback plan if we hit errors — can Ben include an ops checklist in the pilot appendix?
3) Pricing: please show the effective per-token price at 50M and 150M tokens/month so procurement has a clear delta.

If we like what we see, we'll be prepared to move forward toward a 24-month term with staged uplift. See you in the QBR.

Best,
Priya Shah
VP, Platform Engineering | BlueWave Analytics
pshah@bluewave.com
